title: Android 9.0 Pie (ZTE Axon 9 Pro) blocking wakeups from Doze
symptom: After updating to Android 9.0 Pie, XDrip fails to receive data whenever the phone is on battery and screen is off (dozed). With screen on or on connected power, it works perfectly.
fix: An update of Android Pie on the ZTE Axon 9 Pro (to build number ZTE_A2019G_ProV2.1.0B03) fixed the dozing issue, with all battery optimizations disabled.
evidence_quote: first update of Android Pie on my ZTE Axon 9 Pro (to build number ZTE_A2019G_ProV2.1.0B03) fixed dozing issue... XDrip is now working!!! (with all battery optimizations disabled, of course).
